comment: Capability derived from PUBLISHED BENCHMARK SCORES. Replaces v1, where every benchmark field was a placeholder ('Frontier tier', 'Moonshot official') and the self_reported discount fired only on Chinese vendors - capping DeepSeek/Kimi at 0.63 while GPT/Claude sat at 1.00. Policy: (1) two task-matched axes - agentic_cli (Terminal-Bench 2.x) and agentic_swe (SWE-bench Pro/Verified); (2) self_reported is judged by HARNESS OWNERSHIP and applied identically to every vendor; (3) capability = normalized score on the slot's axis, x0.9 when self_reported; (4) scores are NOT comparable across harnesses - `harness` is recorded so the report can say which. v2.1: self_reported is now PER-AXIS (self_reported_cli / self_reported_swe) because a model can have an independent score on one axis and a vendor score on another - GPT-5.6 Sol is independently benchmarked on Terminal-Bench but its SWE-bench Pro figure comes from the same vendor aggregate as everyone else's. Also adds published $/Mtok so the optimizer can reason about VALUE (quality per unit spend), not just quality. v3: full OpenCode Go catalogue as of 2026-08-14 (19 models incl. Grok 4.5, GLM-5.3, Qwen3.8 Max, MiMo-V2.5, Hy3, and GPT-5.6 Luna which is available ON GO). Prices are Go's own published per-Mtok rates. go_usage_allowance_usd is the monthly usage Go includes for that model ($15 or $60) — models at $15 give a quarter the value of $60 models, which is the real generalization of the Kimi-K3 '2x usage' note.

agentic_cli.note: Long-horizon shell/tool tasks. Best predictor for omo agent slots.

tool_multiturn.note: Multi-turn tool coherence and policy adherence across a long dialogue. BFCL grades single calls in isolation; tau grades whether the agent stays coherent over a chain. This is the COMMUNICATOR axis — Sisyphus's ~1,100-line prompt spans dozens of tool calls.

reasoning.note: Expert reasoning depth. The axis for slots whose output GATES execution (Oracle, Momus, ultrabrain) — omo: 'Oracle and Momus use the highest-capability models because their outputs gate execution.'

vision.note: Visual and screen understanding. The VISUAL axis — omo: 'GLM and Kimi are not Gemini substitutes for visual work. Use Qwen.'

gpt-5.6-sol.note: Leads Terminal-Bench 2.1. vals mirror 85.77 on a different scaffold - same rank, lower absolute.
gpt-5.6-sol.axis_note: ESTIMATED from GPT-5.x tau leadership (GPT-5 leads tau-bench retail) and frontier GPQA.

gpt-5.6-luna.note: AVAILABLE ON GO — 2,050 req/5h, the highest-throughput capable model on the plan.
gpt-5.6-luna.axis_note: ESTIMATED. Intelligence Index 52 vs DeepSeek V4 Pro 53; 91.1% GPQA, 80.9% Terminal-Bench per third-party comparison.

gpt-5.5.note: Superseded by 5.6; retained because omo chains still reference it.

kimi-k3.note: Most expensive on Go: only 110 req/5h. LiveBench top open-weight agentic (57.58).
kimi-k3.axis_note: ESTIMATED above K2.6 on the same axes; Moonshot's K3 table leads on agentic rows. LiveBench Agentic Coding 57.58 — top open-weight.

kimi-k2.7-code.note: 1,350 req/5h — 12x K3's throughput at 1/3 the price.
kimi-k2.7-code.axis_note: ESTIMATED between K2.6 and K3; coding-specialised variant.

kimi-k2.6.note: TB2.0 - NOT comparable to 2.1. SWE-bench Verified 80.2.

deepseek-v4-flash.harness: DeepSeek own harness, minimal mode, max effort
deepseek-v4-flash.note: 31,650 req/5h — the highest-throughput model on Go. TB2.1 82.7.
deepseek-v4-flash.axis_note: ESTIMATED from the 0731 agent table; DeepSeek publishes no tau or GPQA figure for Flash.

deepseek-v4-pro.note: Loses to its own Flash sibling on every published agent benchmark.
deepseek-v4-pro.axis_note: GPQA-D 90.1, BrowseComp 83.4, HMMT 95.2. tool_multiturn ESTIMATED from BrowseComp/agent rows — no tau score published.

glm-5.2.note: $60 allowance — 4x GLM-5.3's. Better value than 5.3 until 5.3 is independently scored.

qwen3.6-plus.axis_note: ESTIMATED. Qwen3.6 card: SWE-V 73.4, SWE-Pro 49.5, TB2.0 51.5.

mimo-v2.5-pro.note: TB2.0 68.4 — ahead of DeepSeek V4 Pro (67.9).
mimo-v2.5-pro.axis_note: tau-3 72.9, ClawEval 64.0, GPQA-D 66.7, GDPval 1581 Elo. Strong tool use, notably WEAK reasoning — do not use for gating slots.

minimax-m3.axis_note: GPQA-D 92.68 (high). tool_multiturn ESTIMATED LOW: omo reports MiniMax 'loses coherence on multi-step deep work' — the multi-turn axis is where that shows, and it is excluded from deep slots regardless.

grok-4.5.axis_note: ESTIMATED. DeepSWE 1.0 62.0, SWE Marathon 29.0 (leads that row), LiveBench Agentic 59.8.

glm-5.3.harness: Z.ai launch table; TB3.0 not comparable to 2.1
glm-5.3.note: Z.ai reports DeepSWE v1.1 66.9 vs 5.2's 46.2, but independent DeepSWE put 5.2 at 44% — vendor table runs optimistic. swe carried from 5.2 pending independent replication.
glm-5.3.axis_note: ESTIMATED; carried from 5.2 pending independent replication — Z.ai's launch table runs optimistic (it lists 5.2 at 46.2 DeepSWE where the independent leaderboard shows 44%).

mimo-v2.5.note: ESTIMATED. Cheapest on Go with DeepSeek Flash: 30,100 req/5h.

qwen3.8-max.note: HIGHEST SWE-bench Pro of any Go model (67.7). No SWE-bench Verified published. Vendor-reported, independent replication pending.
qwen3.8-max.axis_note: Toolathlon Verified 72.5; GPQA-D 92.6; OSWorld-Verified 86.1, OmniDocBench 92.1, IFBench 82.8 (Alibaba launch table, Aug 3 2026).

hy3.axis_note: ESTIMATED — Tencent publishes no comparable agent table.

gpt-5.4.note: Legacy; superseded by 5.5/5.6 but still named in omo chains.

gpt-5.4-nano.note: ESTIMATED: no published agentic score. Speed/cost tier.

gpt-5-nano.note: ESTIMATED: no published agentic score. Speed/cost tier.
